notes.title: Hotfix V1.070 Patch Note
notes.notes:
大家好，我是开发者葱色兔兔~，接下来为大家通报今天的更新修复内容：



Game optimization:

After entering the multi weekly session, the experience rewards in the book can be claimed again;

Optimize game performance during battles;

Optimize several terrain details to make characters move better;

The Boss death animation in BossRush is no longer played slowly;



Bug fixes:
To address the issue of abnormal upward input without using a controller: Add a "disable controller" option in the settings interface/graphic settings. If there is no such bug, there is no need to check it;


[img src="https://clan.cdn.queniuqe.com/images//44780535/354e0a50b0cdf0057223189ee4dc260d7508cfd0.png"]




Balance adjustment:

Enemy value adjustment:

The upper limit of enemy level has been changed from 200 to 999; (New changes added)

The enemy's defensive value will no longer increase with level after reaching level 100; (New changes added)

The enemy's defense will no longer increase with level after level 200; (New changes added)

The enemy's attack power does not increase with level after reaching level 100; (Originally existing)

The enemy's understanding does not increase with level after level 100; (Originally existing)

The above numerical changes have little impact on the main process, as there are no enemies exceeding level 100 in one playthrough, and in multi playthrough, the difficulty limit for five playthrough is also around level 200 for enemies. The main purpose of this enemy numerical adjustment is to prepare for the upcoming unlimited battles.

The defensive value (resilience bar) of the enemy's crazy and filthy flag decreases;

Enhance the skill of 'Bloodstained Return' to shake the prison posture: the damage value increases from 8% ->10%;



In addition, if there are any difficult issues with the game, please refer to this announcement~!↓↓↓

https://steamcommunity.com/games/2678640/partnerevents/preview/515218419125059807


[hr][/hr]Subsequent schedule:
Infinite BossRush and more protagonist accessories will be updated for free before September 30th~
[hr][/hr]


Finally, welcome to click on the group link below ↓↓↓, join the group and communicate together~!

notes.title: Bug fixes / Game Troubleshooting Guide.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
ːluvːThe first day of Chao Lu's release has come to an end. Thank you all for your support! ːluvː

You may have noticed that on the first day of release, the game has been updated 5 to 6 times. Now, I'll give you a brief report on the updates. 

Attempted to fix the occasional issue where players are unable to pass through platforms. (If you still encounter this problem, please save the game first, then return to the title screen and reload the save file. This should resolve the issue. We are still closely monitoring and working on this bug!) 

Fixed the issue where the store could bypass quantity limits under certain circumstances. 

Fix several errors and omissions in the map drawing. 

Optimize some plot areas in certain scenarios; 

Optimize some language expressions and fix one omission in the English translation.

 
-Important- Game Troubleshooting[hr][/hr]
Occasional Disarray of Controller Button Positions: 

The in-game controller key map is currently only compatible with Xbox controllers. We are very sorry. 

If the actual functions of the buttons on the controller are disordered, it is very likely caused by the default controller settings of Steam. Please disable Steam input or modify the default controller settings of Steam. 
[hr][/hr]
There is a continuous upward/downward input from the controller, but I didn't press it：

Check the "Disable controller" option in the game's settings interface/graphics settings;

(This bug is extremely occasional and is related to computer hardware and engine input. If this bug occurs, it can currently only be played using keyboard and mouse.)

You can also disable Steam input and disconnect the controller (and delete the connection record between the controller and the computer) to try;
[hr][/hr]
Regarding Archiving: 

When saving the game, it requires very little hard disk space. However, you still need to ensure that the C drive has this remaining capacity; otherwise, you may not be able to save the game or encounter save errors. 
[hr][/hr]
Regarding the sudden exit: 

The issue of sudden crashes is very rare. Currently, most of the reported sudden crashes occur on RTX 4060 devices. 

Solution: 

1.Disable Steam Input; (Right-click on the game/content/controller in the library and select Disable Steam Input) 

2. If the issue persists after disabling Steam input, please check if your graphics card driver is a stable version. 

3. If there is an external gamepad (especially a Switch gamepad), please disconnect it from the computer and then start the game.
[hr][/hr]
SteamDeck Icon Display Issues/Graphical Glitches:
[p align="start"]If you experience incorrect icon displays or screen artifacts while running the game on SteamDeck, please adjust your SteamDeck's compatibility layer to a more stable compatibility version to resolve the issue.
[hr][/hr]
When using SteamDeck/gamepad, interactive prompts display keyboard/mouse controls instead of gamepad-specific cues:
[p align="start"]This issue arises from Steam's simulated keyboard/mouse mapping layout, commonly occurring on SteamDeck. To resolve: press the 'Steam Button' on your SteamDeck, open Controller Settings, and change the current controller layout from keyboard/mouse to gamepad mode.
[hr][/hr]


Finally, I wish you a wonderful experience on your journey of exploration!ːluvː

best regards, 

Scallion Rabbit on August 15, 2025

notes.title: The New Product Festival is approaching! Demo update!
Since November 2024, the Demo (trial version) has been updated 21 times.
Demo Update to：V1.055
Demo Update to：V1.035
notes.notes:
To bring you a good experience is an important goal of "JOR: Dawn Dew". To this end, the free trial version has undergone  major updates . At the same time, the content of the official version is also in progress - your attention is the biggest encouragement for "JOR: Dawn Dew" ~

 Here are the main updates: 

 -- Content Update --
 New scene "Sea Gap" : unique challenges and tasks here.
 Item system major revision: Items are no longer consumables, you can use them as much as you like!
 Added difficulty options: 3 difficulty levels to choose from.
 New mission system: When you feel lost in your goal, the mission can help you anchor your direction. But it will never bother you when you want to explore freely.
 New equipment preset function: save your carefully built combat mode, more convenient to experience different combat schools.
 Added "Beast Tide Source Point" : a new challenge point in the scene, where you can meet multiple enemy challenges.
 Optimize character movements and expressions, optimize skill performance;
 Added unique text animation for killing bosses


-- Game changes --
 Attitude changed from 5 to 4
 The maximum number of heart points carried was changed from 8 to 10, and the initial capacity was changed to 6 points
 Modify the game's opening words
 Unclassify material items and change them all to items


-- Correlation optimization --
 Player locations are always visible on the map, and NPC locations are displayed on the map
 Redraw all pose ICONS
 Optimize battle scene layout
 Optimized some monster skeleton animations
 Optimize map design and adjust resource distribution
 Optimize UI interface performance;

Tips:
 As the game is in the development stage, the system has been greatly changed, so the new version Demo does not support the old version Demo archive, I would like to express my sincere apologies to you. 

Finally, as a personal development of the game, your suggestions are very important to me,  you can join the QQ group: 932066312, and directly communicate with me.
